reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our DM: she should keep Tuesday 10 Nov at 14:30 free for the Brindle call.

That time comes from her own DM to me on 14 Oct. She said her standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Brindle rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 14:30. I found it in the brain, in the copy of our DMs that only Dana can see. Our DM history itself only shows today's message.

I found nothing in #north-team or elsewhere since then that changes the time. Her calendar has no events next week, so I suggested she add one to block the slot. I didn't create or change any calendar entries.
